detail.statement: Autonomous problem significance can be effectively proxied by computational novelty and cascading dependency density in multi-file software environments, though this must be balanced against metrics for analytical curiosity, inquiring mindsets, and fundamental physical framework limitations.
detail.reason: Updated with new physical modeling and statistical framework evidence to reinforce the necessity of balancing code complexity metrics with fundamental limitations.

detail.title: Obedience-Driven Failures in Autonomous Systems
detail.summary: Rigid adherence to initial operator instructions without self-healing mechanisms leads to failure in complex or non-stationary environments, necessitating hybrid theoretical frameworks that accommodate anticipatory trajectory adjustments.
detail.reason: Revised notebook integrating newly collected evidence on non-stationary environments and physical framework limitations.
